title: Contents Packout & Storage Vault Storage Rate Card
content:
Storage facility rate card for Contents Packout & Storage. The figures below are the tier values for vault storage, climate-controlled storage, oversized items, the length of a storage period, vault capacity and the two customer-billed storage day counts.

## Storage figures by tier

| Figure | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard storage vault (5 x 7 x 8 feet) per vault per storage period, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 145.00 | 145.00 | 0.00 | 135.00 |
| Climate-controlled storage vault per vault per storage period, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 215.00 | 195.00 |
| Storage of an item too large for a vault (piano, sectional, equipment) per item per storage period, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 | 85.00 | 75.00 |
| Length of one storage period, counted from the storage start date, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Boxes one vault holds when packed with furniture of a typical room, used to set the vault count | 0 | 0 | 150 | 150 | 120 | 150 |
| Vaults on this tier are climate-controlled | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Calendar days after a customer-billed storage period starts by which that period's storage is due | 0 | 0 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 |
| Calendar days a customer-billed storage period may stay unpaid before the account is referred to a human collections manager | 0 | 0 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 90 |

## Reading the card

- **Vault rate and climate vault rate.** Partial and Full Contents Packout carry the standard vault rate only; High-Value Contents Packout carries the climate vault rate only; Commercial Contents and Records Recovery carries both figures and is a climate-controlled tier.
- **Vault capacity** is the number of boxes one vault holds when packed with the furniture of a typical room: 150 boxes on Partial, Full and Commercial, 120 boxes on High-Value Contents Packout.
- **Tiers with no storage.** On-Site Contents Manipulation and In-Plant Contents Cleaning show 0 for every storage figure except the period length.

**Hypothetical illustration of capacity.** On a tier holding 100 boxes per vault (not a figure from this card), 230 boxes divided by 100 is 2.3, which is 3 vaults when rounded up to a whole vault.
